title: Violin with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Body of violin -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="26" ry="30" fill="#C87941"/>
  <!-- Waist curves -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="18" ry="30" fill="#E89B5A"/>
  <!-- Upper bout -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="38" rx="18" ry="14" fill="#C87941"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="38" rx="12" ry="14" fill="#E89B5A"/>
  <!-- Lower bout highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="80" rx="22" ry="14" fill="#C87941"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="80" rx="16" ry="14" fill="#E89B5A"/>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <rect x="46" y="10" width="8" height="22" rx="2" fill="#8B5A2B"/>
  <!-- Scroll -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="10" r="6" fill="#A0703A"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="10" r="3" fill="#C89050"/>
  <!-- F-holes -->
  <path d="M36 52 Q34 62 37 72" stroke="#5C3A1E" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M64 52 Q66 62 63 72" stroke="#5C3A1E" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Bridge -->
  <rect x="42" y="66" width="16" height="4" rx="1" fill="#6B4226"/>
  <!-- Strings -->
  <line x1="46" y1="32" x2="46" y2="82" stroke="#E8C87A" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="32" x2="50" y2="82" stroke="#E8C87A" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="54" y1="32" x2="54" y2="82" stroke="#E8C87A" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Tailpiece -->
  <polygon points="45,84 55,84 52,78 48,78" fill="#6B4226"/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="44" cy="47" rx="3.5" ry="4" fill="#2D1B0E"/>
  <ellipse cx="56" cy="47" rx="3.5" ry="4" fill="#2D1B0E"/>
  <circle cx="45.2" cy="45.8" r="1.3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="57.2" cy="45.8" r="1.3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M42 54 Q50 62 58 54" stroke="#2D1B0E" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Blush -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="53" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#E06050" opacity="0.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="53" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#E06050" opacity="0.5"/>
  <!-- Chin rest -->
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="78" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#4A2810"/>
  <!-- Bow -->
  <rect x="18" y="20" width="3" height="70" rx="1.5" fill="#8B5A2B" transform="rotate(-15 20 55)"/>
  <line x1="21" y1="18" x2="12" y2="88" stroke="#E8C87A" stroke-width="1.5" transform="rotate(-15 20 55)"/>
</svg>
